about.headline: Bridging Python web engineering, software development, and embedded IoT innovation.
paragraphs: I am a Computer Science & Engineering graduate from Varendra University with a strong academic foundation and hands-on technical versatility. My primary focus is building full-stack web applications using the Python programming language along with modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Beyond Python web development, I have extensive working experience in C, C++, Java, and PHP, complemented by robust database design and query optimization in MS SQL Server. I am also proficient in everyday professional productivity suites including MS Word, MS Excel, and MS PowerPoint.
I have a deep passion for electronics and hardware innovation, actively designing and building IoT and embedded projects utilizing Arduino and ESP32 microcontrollers.

With a high typing speed of 60 WPM, strong analytical discipline, and a consistent track record of academic excellence (GPA 5.00 in both SSC & HSC, and CGPA 3.52 in B.Sc. CSE), I am committed to delivering clean, efficient, and impactful solutions.
